I am an old woman here in SNNP, and this small plot near my house is where I grow my enset and some coffee with a few fruit trees mixed in. I cannot afford to buy chemical fertilizer for this plot — the price is too high and the rains come well enough here. I put the manure from my few animals and the kitchen ash on the enset, because that is what my mother taught me and it keeps the plants strong. My children help me weed and harvest, so I do not need to hire anyone for such a small piece of land.
